calculate_l2_loss: calculate the L2 loss of predictions with respect to targets or use as L2 regularizer
compute_likelihood: compute the likelihood of predictions with respect to targets handling 0**0 edge cases
compute_log_loss: compute the log loss of predictions with respect to targets using likelihood
calculate_pixel_control_loss: calculate n-step Q-learning loss for pixel control auxiliary task with Q(lambda)
compute_expectile_loss: compute expectile loss that weighs over- and under-estimations of targets differently
